messages.speaker: Narrator
messages.text:
The orchard house is smaller than you remember.

On the kitchen table sits a ledger, a ring of old keys, and a note in Eleanor Pike's neat handwriting.

(Eleanor Pike) "If you mean to keep the place, start with the accounts. Trees forgive neglect slower than people do."
